data.title: Fast stable sulfide electrolytes
constraints: Li diffusion at least as fast as parent

data.goal: Find new sulfide solid electrolytes for lithium-metal batteries, derived from Li7P3S11 or beta-Li3PS4, that conduct lithium at least as fast as their parent and stay stable against lithium metal. Learn from the candidates that fail.

proposals.rationale: Double Cl doping doubles Li vacancies for faster diffusion and forms LiCl interphase stable against Li metal.
Dilute O in Li7P3S11 should form passivating phosphate while preserving sulfide conduction better than higher O content.
Single Na pillar expands Li7P3S11 channels for Li motion with less blocking risk than double Na doping.

reply.hypothesis: Combine Li-vacancy creation by halogens with dilute O passivation and Na expansion to boost conduction and Li-metal stability.

data.text: Iteration 1 tested halogen-driven Li vacancies with dilute O passivation and Na expansion. Li5P2S7Cl, Li14P6S21O and NaLi13(P3S11)2 all passed the stability and insulation filters with energy above the hull of about 0.05, 0.02 and 0.01 eV per atom and band gaps of about 2.6, 2.5 and 2.4 eV. All three failed slow tests: Li5P2S7Cl showed framework motion with Cl diffusing at 17.7 percent of Li, Li14P6S21O showed framework motion with O diffusing at 5.3 percent of Li, and NaLi13(P3S11)2 was non-passivating against Li metal with a reaction of 2.44 eV per atom forming metallic Na. The agent concluded to limit halogens to one per cell and prefer larger Br or I, avoid isolated O in favor of clustered PO4-like units or isovalent Se, and drop Na mixing for non-reducible Mg vacancy or P-site As Sb substitutions, prioritizing dilute isovalent Se and As plus Mg-vacancy variants on mp-985583 Li3PS4.

data.text: In iteration 3 the agent tested isovalent Se/As expansions on Li3PS4 and a single large Br substitution intended to keep the framework intact on Li13P6S21Br, correcting earlier Cl/O motion issues. Li3PSeS3, Li12As3PS16 and Li13P6S21Br all passed stability and band gap filtering with energy above the hull around -0.01 eV per atom for the first two and 0.03 eV per atom for Li13P6S21Br, and gaps near 2.4 eV, 2.3 eV and 2.4 eV respectively. Molecular dynamics at 600 K showed Li13P6S21Br tied with its parent with diffusion ratio 1.01 ± 0.20, confirming the intact-framework Br substitution fixes motion, and the agent concluded isovalent As/Se substitutions are the most stable on Li3PS4 and will submit the Se/As candidates to diffusion and Li-contact tests.

reply.executive_summary: The search sought sulfide electrolytes derived from Li7P3S11 or beta-Li3PS4 that conduct lithium at least as fast as the parent and remain stable against lithium metal. The champion is Li6P2SeS7 derived from Li3PS4, with space group Pmc2_1. Its energy above the hull is -0.007 eV/atom with an error bar of 0.005 eV/atom. Its band gap is 2.485 eV and 3.102 eV. Its electrochemical window is stable from 1.8 V to 2.24 V and its behavior against lithium metal is passivating. Its diffusion coefficient at 600 K is 3.9e-06 cm2/s with an error of 9.6e-07 cm2/s, with a verdict of tied with its parent. Its ionic conductivity at 300 K is an extrapolated estimate of 0.098 mS/cm within 0.012 to 0.8 mS/cm by own Arrhenius fit at 500, 600, 700 K, with a verdict of tied with its parent whose range is 0.446 to 3.348 mS/cm. The other two finalists Li12P4SeS15 and Li7P3SeS10 share the same level of tied with its parent at 300 K. Excluded candidates failed because the framework moved in molecular dynamics with Cl or O diffusion, or because the reaction against lithium metal was non-passivating with metallic products. Measured ionic conductivity, DFT checks, synthesis routes, cost, and experimental data were not computed.
champion_reasons: All three finalists share the level tied with its parent at 300 K, so Li6P2SeS7 comes first by the convention of lowest energy above the hull per substitution, then lowest activation energy, then widest electrochemical window, not by a significant conductivity difference.
Its energy above the hull per substitution of -0.115 eV is lower than -0.113 eV for Li12P4SeS15 and 0.323 eV for Li7P3SeS10.
Its stable window from 1.8 V to 2.24 V matches Li12P4SeS15 from 1.8 V to 2.24 V and is wider than Li7P3SeS10 from 2.28 V to 2.3 V.

Its energy above the hull of -0.007 eV/atom with an error bar of 0.005 eV/atom differs from Li12P4SeS15 at -0.004 eV/atom within the error bars, while the difference to Li7P3SeS10 at 0.015 eV/atom is larger than the error bars.
tradeoffs: Its window from 1.8 V to 2.24 V is narrow for pairing with high-voltage cathodes.
Its reaction energy with lithium iron phosphate is -0.145 eV/atom, indicating cathode reactivity.
Its conductivity estimate of 0.098 mS/cm within 0.012 to 0.8 mS/cm spans almost two orders of magnitude, so high conductivity is not assured.
Its activation energy is 0.421 eV with an error of 0.104 eV, compared with 0.335 eV for the parent.
uncertainties: Room-temperature conductivity is an extrapolated estimate from molecular dynamics at 500 to 700 K, not a measurement.
Diffusion was assessed at 600 K with an error of 9.6e-07 cm2/s, so low-temperature behavior remains uncertain.
Energies carry an error bar of 0.005 eV/atom from the mean difference on 25 known compounds of Li-P-S-Se.
The window assessment involves polysulfides LiS4, P2S7 and SeS7 with a shift of 0.025 eV/atom, which limits confidence.

synthesis.text: Try ball milling of lithium sulfide, phosphorus sulfide and selenium precursors then annealing under inert atmosphere, without guarantee of success.
Try glass-ceramic annealing near the crystallization of the parent sulfide to favor the substituted phase, without guarantee of success.

limitations: Measured ionic conductivity was not computed and the 300 K values are extrapolated estimates with their range.
DFT calculations were not computed and UMA energies carry an error bar.
Synthesis routes were not computed and the candidates are computational predictions, not proven materials.
Cost of the elements and experimental data including moisture stability and long cycling were not computed and still need validation.
